{{Quote|Once you were with me, here in the Maw. Once you were all with me. Now you are apart, but one by one, you are all awakening. And once awake, you can hear my call, and come to me.|Abeloth|<ref name="Allies" />}}
'''Force psychosis''' was a mental disease that began affecting several young [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] following the [[Second Galactic Civil War]]. The disease caused mental deterioration in the individual's brain which manifested itself as a paranoia resulting in the belief that everyone that the being knew&mdash;except for other affected beings&mdash;was an impostor. Several of the afflicted subjects were captured by the [[New Jedi Order|Jedi Order]] to be studied, and it was found that the Jedi who developed the psychosis were able to display rare [[Force power/Legends|Force powers]] that [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Darth Caedus|Jacen Solo]] had learned, but the psychotic Knights could not have learned themselves. However, another afflicted Knight, [[Bazel Warv]], showed the ability [[Phase|to alter the density of matter]], a power that Solo never possessed.

Members of the [[Mind Walkers]]&mdash;a group of [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitives]] who lived at [[Sinkhole Station]], a [[Space station/Legends|space station]] in [[Maw Cluster/Legends|the Maw]]&mdash;had contracted and experienced similar symptoms earlier in their lives. However, after living at the station and traveling to a realm of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] known as [[beyond shadows]], their paranoia was replaced with a belief that nothing was real except for the Force itself. Eventually, [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and his son, [[Ben Skywalker|Ben]], allied themselves with a [[Lost Tribe of Sith|group]] of [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] and embarked on a [[Mission to the Maw|mission]] to the Maw to destroy [[Abeloth]], a [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] entity whom they suspected was the cause of the psychosis. Despite the attempt of the Sith to betray the Jedi and force Abeloth to serve them, Skywalker defeated Abeloth, and the beings who had been affected by the psychosis were then instantly cured. As the Sith and Jedi continued investigating Abeloth, however, they learned that she had survived and fled.

When Sith [[High Lord (Circle of Lords)|High Lord]] [[Sarasu Taalon]] [[Duel at the Pool of Knowledge|bathed]] in the [[Pool of Knowledge]], he began to turn into the same kind of entity as Abeloth, until he was [[Battle in the Fallanassi village|killed]] by [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]] [[Vestara Khai]], although Abeloth escaped once more. Since she was not dead, Luke suspected that keeping her weakened was the only thing keeping the minds of the formerly psychotic Knights free. However, following the [[Raid on Detention Center 81|rescue]] of [[Valin Horn|Valin]] and [[Jysella Horn]] from [[Carbonite/Legends|carbonite]], they retained their psychosis. Another [[Operation Shieldfall|battle]] with Abeloth freed the Horn siblings from her control. As Abeloth recovered, however, she was able to influence several Sith into [[Destruction of Tahv|betraying]] their Tribe and [[Abeloth's fleet|joining]] her.

==History==
===Rise of the psychosis in the Jedi Knights===
{{Quote|Valin, I'm going to call your father now.''"<br />"''No, you're not. You know what you're going to do instead?''"<br />"''What?''"<br />"''You're going to tell me what you've done with my mother!|Mirax Horn and Valin Horn, upon the onset of the psychosis in Valin|<ref name="Outcast" />}}
[[File:JainaSolo_EssentialAtlas.jpg|thumb|left|150px|Jedi Knight Jaina Solo]]
The [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] being [[Abeloth]] used her influence over the minds of [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitives]] to draw them to her in [[Maw Cluster/Legends|the Maw]], so that she could feed off of their life energy and strengthen herself. She used her [[Force power/Legends|powers]] to make the [[The Force/Legends|Force]]-sensitives believe that only the Force was real, thus making them believe that everyone who had not fallen under her influence was an impostor.<ref name="Allies" /><ref name="Abyss" /> She exercised her influence from at least the [[Time/Legends|days]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and [[Jedi Order/Legends|Old Jedi Order]], although she did so only rarely at first, and the situation remained unnoticed by the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]].<ref name="Abyss" />

The [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Seff Hellin]] fell under Abeloth's influence and was the first Jedi to be noted by the [[New Jedi Order]] for acting strangely.<ref name="Falcon">[[Millennium Falcon (novel)|''Millennium Falcon'']]</ref> Later, the Jedi Knight [[Valin Horn]] contracted the psychosis and was apprehended by his [[Parent/Legends|father]], [[Corran Horn/Legends|Corran]], and mother, [[Mirax Terrik Horn|Mirax]]. He later escaped, however, and was finally captured by the Jedi Order after a long manhunt. The [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances]] [[The Galactic Federation of Free Alliances versus Valin Horn|decided]] that Horn was too dangerous to be confined in a normal [[Prison/Legends|prison]], though, so he was [[Carbon-freezing/Legends|encased]] in [[Carbonite/Legends|carbonite]] and placed in the [[Armand Isard Correctional Facility]]. Hellin discovered Horn's presence there and attempted to rescue him, but he was instead [[Raid on the Armand Isard Correctional Facility|captured]] by [[Darkmeld]]&mdash;an organization formed by Jedi Knight [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]] to counter [[Chief of State (Galactic Alliance)|Chief of State]] [[Natasi Daala]]'s [[Anti-Jedi sentiment/Legends|anti-Jedi]] policies. [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Cilghal]] then began to conduct a secret study of the disease in Hellin in the [[New Jedi Temple|Jedi Temple]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="Outcast" /> Shortly afterward, Horn's sister [[Jysella Horn|Jysella]] also contracted the psychosis, and after a [[Skirmish on the Processional Way|duel]] with fellow Knights [[Bazel Warv]] and [[Yaqeel Saav'etu]], she was captured by [[Galactic Alliance Security]] forces. [[Natua Wan]], a [[Falleen/Legends|Falleen]] Knight, also fell under Abeloth's influence. She was subsequently [[Coruscant Livestock Exchange and Exhibition|apprehended]] by Jedi Knights [[Radd Minker]], Jaina Solo, and [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]], and brought to the Temple to be studied.<ref name="Omen" />

After studying Hellin's brain, Cilghal discovered that he had been experiencing dreams while he was awake. It was also found that several of the affected Knights were able to display rare Force powers that [[Darth Caedus|Jacen Solo]] had possessed and that the Knights could not have learned themselves.<ref name="Omen" /> Additional research found that the symptoms of the disease were lessened if the victim was cut off or isolated from the Force for extended periods of time. This revelation led some [[Jedi healer/Legends|healers]] to suggest that the disease may have been transmitted through the Force itself. It was noted by Cilghal that all those who were affected with the disease had been stationed on [[Shelter]] in [[Maw Cluster/Legends|the Maw]] during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]].<ref name="Abyss" />

===Rising tensions with the Galactic Alliance===
[[File:Jaggedwithbeard.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Jagged Fel, who assisted in the capture of Saav'etu and Warv]]
{{Quote|He ''[Sothais Saar]'' ran into Jedi Master Cilghal, dueled with her briefly, and was flattened like a bug. She commandeered a passing commercial speeder and took him back to the Temple. The Coruscant Security officers I dispatched to the Jedi Temple are there now and have issued an order to the Jedi. They must turn over Jedi Saar within the hour or there will be consequences.''"<br />"Will ''there be consequences?''"<br />"''Oh, yes. Defninitely, yes.|Chief of State Natasi Daala, to her aide, Wynn Dorvan; regarding Sothais Saar and the upcoming Mandalorian raid on the Jedi Temple|<ref name="Backlash" />}}
After being isolated inside an [[Ysalamiri/Legends|ysalamir]]-induced Force bubble, Hellin began showing signs of recovery. Meanwhile, Saav'etu and Warv also contracted the disease, although Warv was able to recognize Organa Solo as a non-impostor for a brief time. The two Knights were captured by Organa Solo, her daughter, Jaina, [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]] [[Head of State/Legends|Head of State]] [[Jagged Fel]], and [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]]. A Galactic Alliance Security force under the command of [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Atar]] attempted to arrest the two psychotic Jedi, but Fel and the Solos managed to get the Jedi to safety. It was also noted that Warv was able to [[Phase|alter the density of matter]], a power which Solo never displayed. Later, Warv, Saav'etu, Wan, and Hellin were [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggled]] offworld to [[Shedu Maad]] in the [[Hapes Cluster/Legends|Hapes Cluster]] in order to escape conviction by the Galactic Alliance. A group of Jedi and press also gained access to the [[Galactic Alliance Security Detention Center 81|blockhouse]] where the Horn siblings were being held. They found the Horns' carbonite blocks suspended over a fish tank in the executive offices of the building, garnering sympathy for the Jedi from the public.<ref name="Abyss" />

Meanwhile, [[Exile (punishment)/Legends|exiled]] Jedi [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and his son, [[Ben Skywalker]], had embarked on a quest to learn more about the cause of [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Caedus' fall to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]]. During their travel they saw Jedi Knight [[Qwallo Mode]]&mdash;who had gone missing a [[42 ABY|year previously]] and had been presumed [[Death/Legends|dead]]&mdash;floating in the [[Vacuum/Legends|vacuum]] of [[Realspace/Legends|space]] without a [[Environment suit/Legends|vac suit]]. Their journey soon after led them to [[Sinkhole Station]], a [[Space station/Legends|space station]] in the Maw that was home to a group of Force-sensitives known as the [[Mind Walkers]]. There, they found Mode and discovered that he had also been inflicted with the psychosis. However, he recognized the Skywalkers and did not believe them to be impostors. The Jedi interacted with the Mind Walkers, who possessed the ability to separate their minds from their bodies in order to travel in a realm of the Force known as [[beyond shadows]]. Luke Skywalker traveled in the realm as his Mind Walker guides showed him the places that they had taken Caedus during his visit. Ben eventually grew concerned for his father and convinced the Mind Walker [[Rhondi Tremaine]] to take him beyond shadows, too. After catching up to his father, they saw Abeloth&mdash;known to the Mind Walkers as the "Lady in the Mists"&mdash;in the [[Mists of Forgetfulness]]. They intended to travel toward her to discover what exactly she was, but after speaking with the spirit of Caedus in the [[Lake of Apparitions]], they decided that they needed to return to their physical bodies. The decision proved to be correct&mdash;the Jedi were [[Skirmish at Sinkhole Station|ambushed]] by a [[Lost Tribe of Sith strike team|strike team]] of [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] from the [[Lost Tribe of Sith|Lost Tribe]] on [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]]. They defeated the Sith, however, and Ben later conjectured that Abeloth was causing the illness.<ref name="Abyss" />

[[File:Cilghalcolor.jpg|thumb|left|125px|Jedi Master Cilghal]]
Shortly after, a [[Chev]] Jedi Knight, [[Sothais Saar]], developed the psychosis while reporting to [[Wynn Dorvan]], Daala's personal [[Aide/Legends|aide]], in the [[Senate Building/Legends|Senate Building]]. After escaping to the [[Senate Plaza/Legends|Senate Plaza]], Saar was [[Duel in the Senate Plaza|confronted]] by Cilghal, who captured him before [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Coruscant Security Forces]] could arrive. The Security Forces attempted to force the Jedi to hand Saar over, but the Jedi refused. In retaliation, Daala sent a task force of [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]] to [[Raid on the New Jedi Temple|attack]] the Jedi Temple.<ref name="Backlash" />

===Abeloth's defeat===
{{Quote|I am&hellip;delighted beyond words to report that all three of the ill Jedi appear to have made a full recovery.''"<br />"''What? All of them? How?''"<br />"''I'm not sure, but it seemed to happen to all of them simultaneously. We've run test after test; all three seem to be back to their old selves. My best guess is that, somehow, Master Skywalker was successful in his quest to find a cure.|Jedi Master Cilghal and Grand Master Kenth Hamner|<ref name="Allies" />}}
Later, the Sith confronted the Skywalkers on [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]] and allied with the Jedi in an effort to eliminate Abeloth; although the Sith's true motive was to betray and kill the Jedi and force Abeloth to serve under them. The allied forces traveled first to [[Klatooine/Legends|Klatooine]] to restock on supplies before embarking on their [[Mission to the Maw|mission]]. There, the Force-sensitive [[Dyon Stadd]] succumbed to the psychosis while planet-side with Ben Skywalker and the [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]] [[Vestara Khai]]. He was captured and taken into custody aboard the ''[[Jade Shadow]]''. Meanwhile, several more Jedi on Coruscant began to develop the psychosis, including the [[Human/Legends|Human]] Jedi [[Kunor Bann]] and [[Turi Altamik]], prompting Cilghal to write a report on the psychotic Jedi, presenting her worry that the number of Jedi developing the illness was rapidly increasing.<ref name="Allies" />

While Bann had been captured inside the Jedi Temple, Altamik had managed to escape the Temple and lead a chase that was caught on [[Holocamera/Legends|holocam]] by [[Journalist/Legends|journalist]] [[Javis Tyrr]] before she was finally captured by the Jedi. The Galactic Alliance began demanding custody of Altamik and Saar, and when the Jedi refused to turn the two over, Daala ordered a Mandalorian [[Siege of the New Jedi Temple|siege]] of the Jedi Temple. The Jedi, trapped inside the Temple, began to run low on supplies, including the medications they were using on their psychotic captives. However, Leia Solo came up with a plan to use the Force [[Animal bond|to compel]] some rodents into service. She then used them to sneak supplies in to the Jedi Temple.<ref name="Allies" />

[[File:Luke_Skywalker_EA.jpg|thumb|right|150px|Exiled Grand Master Luke Skywalker]]
Meanwhile, as the Sith and Jedi continued on their mission, they discovered that Sinkhole Station had been destroyed, and suspected that Abeloth had been confined there, but that she had finally grown powerful enough to break free. They traveled straight to a [[Abeloth's planet|planet]] in the Maw where Khai and the strike team that attacked the Jedi at Sinkhole Station had met Abeloth. There, the Skywalkers realized that the locations they had seen beyond shadows corresponded to real locations on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. As Skywalker and three Sith attempted and failed to locate Abeloth by traveling beyond shadows, Khai pretended to help Stadd by allowing him to escape his confinement aboard the ''Jade Shadow''. In reality, however, she had placed a [[Homing beacon/Legends|homing beacon]] on him. The Jedi and Sith followed him to Abeloth's cave, where they found that Abeloth had drained his life force and then fled deeper into the cave, leaving Stadd for dead. After coming into contact with her, Stadd finally realized that Abeloth was not what she claimed to be. Although he still felt as though he were surrounded by impostors, he realized that this was based solely on her influence and thus knew it was a lie. The Jedi and Sith finally found Abeloth, but she took on the appearance of [[Callista Ming]] and pretended to be Skywalker's long-lost lover. He soon realized that it was a lie, however, and attacked Abeloth. During the ensuing skirmish, Skywalker apparently killed Abeloth, resulting in the termination of her induced psychosis and the instant cure of all affected beings. Cilghal reported the sudden cure of Saar, Altamik, and Bann to interim Grand Master [[Kenth Hamner]].<ref name="Allies" />

===Recovery===
{{Dialogue|Tharn|Jedi Saar, please tell me why your hands are raised.|Saar|Because I don't want to be blasted?|Tharn|That seems reasonable. Jedi Altamik, can you explain why those Mandalorians might want to blast you and Jedi Saar?|Altamik|Sure&mdash;Sothais and I have been a bit barvy lately. But we're better now, Chief Daala&hellip;''honest we are''.|attr=Thalleus Tharn begins examination of Sothais Saar and Turi Altamik|src=<ref name="Vortex" />}}
Saar and Altamik were then presented to Daala in the [[Fellowship Plaza]] and examined by [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Thalleus Tharn]] under Daala's orders. They were proclaimed sane, and the siege was lifted. However, the Sith and Jedi on Abeloth's planet meanwhile discovered that the entity had not actually died. As they continued to search for her, the [[High Lord (Circle of Lords)|Sith High Lord]] [[Sarasu Taalon]] bathed in the [[Pool of Knowledge]] and began to change into the same kind of entity as Abeloth. However, the Sith and Jedi alliance [[Duel at the Pool of Knowledge|ended]], and the Skywalkers and Khai tracked Abeloth to the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Pydyr]]. They soon learned that she was living among the [[Fallanassi/Legends|Fallanassi]], and Luke found that she was using the [[White Current/Legends|White Current]] to create the illusion of a planetary plague&mdash;succeeding in tricking all of the Sith and Jedi except for Luke Skywalker.<ref name="Vortex" />

[[File:KenthHamner-Vortex.jpg|thumb|left|150px|Kenth Hamner]]
Meanwhile, on Coruscant, strife grew within the Jedi Order. The [[Jedi High Council (New Jedi Order)|Jedi Council]] desired to act quickly to rescue the Horns and help the Skywalkers by sending out a strike team of [[StealthX]]s, but Hamner wanted to negotiate with Daala for the Horns and delay the launch, since he had made a deal with [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Nek Bwua'tu]] during the siege of the Temple to wait until the Admiral's word to send the StealthXs, in return for cooperation of the [[Galactic Alliance Defense Fleet|Alliance navy]] with the Jedi. However, Bwua'tu had since been [[Attempted assassination of Admiral Nek Bwua'tu|attacked]] by [[Assassin/Legends|assassins]], leaving him in a coma. The Jedi Masters grew frustrated with Hamner's inaction, and when they learned of the deal he had made with Bwua'tu&mdash;in which he had neglected to consult with them&mdash;they removed him as acting Grand Master and decided to launch the StealthXs. Hamner [[Skirmish in the Operations Hangar|attempted]] to stop the launch, but failed, and fell to his death from a catwalk in the [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]]. Afterward, Master [[Saba Sebatyne]] was voted unanimously to take his place as interim Grand Master.<ref name="Vortex" />

On Pydyr, Khai had called for reinforcements, and three shuttles of Sith arrived with Taalon. Taalon decided not to kill the Jedi yet, as they might still prove useful, but in the ensuing [[Battle in the Fallanassi village|confrontation]] with Abeloth, Skywalker killed another of Abeloth's bodies&mdash;the Fallanassi [[Akanah Norand Goss Pell]]&mdash;and Taalon was killed by Khai in order to prevent him from becoming another Abeloth. However, when the other Sith learned that Khai had killed him, unaware as they were of why, she was forced to flee with the Skywalkers, who escaped under cover of the arriving StealthX wing, and continued to chase after Abeloth. Luke suspected that it was their constant pressure on Abeloth, keeping her weak, that was making her lose control of her influence over the Jedi Knights' minds, and thus did not want to lose her.<ref name="Vortex" />

Meanwhile, the [[Raid on Detention Center 81|rescue]] of the Horns was successful, and they were brought back to the Jedi Temple to be freed from carbonite. Though they acted normal upon their reawakening, it was just an attempt to throw the Jedi off&mdash;the Horn siblings retained the psychosis. Through a careful pretense of full recovery, the Horn siblings succeeded in being assigned missions, giving them the chance to escape from Coruscant. Upon coming into contact with journalist [[Kandra Nilitz]], they traveled to the planet [[Nam Chorios/Legends|Nam Chorios]], where Abeloth was in hiding. There, they deserted Nilitz, and Jysella commandeered one of the planet's defending [[Golan III Space Defense NovaGun|gun platforms]] while Valin located Abeloth on the surface. However, Khai and the Skywalkers were also searching for Abeloth on Nam Chorios, and they found her and severely weakened her, causing the Horn siblings to be freed from their psychosis. The Skywalkers, Khai, and the Horns escaped while a Jedi StealthX wing [[Operation Shieldfall|defeated]] Sith forces in orbit.<ref name="Conviction" />

Soon afterward, however, [[Sith Saber]] [[Gavar Khai]], Vestara Khai's father, and several other Sith [[Destruction of Tahv|defected]] from the Sith Tribe to join Abeloth's [[Abeloth's fleet|forces]], as her influence over him grew stronger. Khai was later killed in a [[Duel on Dromund Kaas|duel]] with his daughter, and during the duel, she realized that he had fallen under Abeloth's influence.<ref name="Ascension" />

==Symptoms==
[[File:GavarKhai-Allies.jpg|thumb|right|150px|Sith Saber Gavar Khai]]
{{Quote|Jedi Saar, I suspect I know what you are experiencing.''"<br />"''What have you done with Master Cilghal?''"<br />"''I know how this conversation progresses. There is no point to it. You cannot be reasoned with.|Cilghal and Saar, shortly before their duel|<ref name="Backlash" />}}
The symptoms of the psychosis included a general paranoia, accompanied with the belief that everyone had been replaced by impostors, except for other similarly affected beings. Moreover, the infected Jedi were able to instinctively use rare Force powers which they did not have before contracting the psychosis.<ref name="Outcast" /> Several Mind Walkers experienced similar symptoms before joining the group at Sinkhole Station, where they came to believe that nothing was real except for the Force. This belief eased the psychotic beings' paranoia&mdash;Mode and the other Mind Walkers did not believe the Skywalkers to be impostors.<ref name="Abyss" /> Another symptom was the belief that Abeloth and the other affected beings were the only truthful, trustworthy beings in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. While affected, Stadd felt that Abeloth desired him, and he viewed her as beautiful until the moment he came into true contact with her, when she began to draw upon his life energy and he realized that her influence had been a lie.<ref name="Allies" /> Later, when Gavar Khai fell under Abeloth's influence, he was convinced to desert the Lost Tribe even though Abeloth had just killed his [[Lahka Khai|wife]]. He later made a claim that losing his wife and even his daughter did not matter to him, as he could replace both. The irrationalities he showed during his duel against his daughter revealed to her that he was no longer the same being he had once been.<ref name="Ascension" />

==Behind the scenes==
Force psychosis first appeared briefly in the novel [[Millennium Falcon (novel)|''Millennium Falcon'']]. It later played a significant role in the [[Star Wars: Fate of the Jedi|''Fate of the Jedi'']] series.

Force psychosis is similar to the real-life condition known as [[Wikipedia:Capgras delusion|Capgras delusion]].
